verdict.rationale: Airweave is a context-retrieval layer for agents, so session memory or summaries of past conversations is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence covers only syncing and searching external data sources (via the API, MCP server, CLI, and SDKs), with nothing on storing, summarizing, or resuming prior agent sessions or threads. Searching synced app content is not the same as getting summaries of past sessions.
